title: Representation by Design in Generation: Cross-View Class-Token Alignment in Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.36348v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative and representation learning remain asymmetrically connected: semantic representations are used to improve diffusion generation, whereas the models' own representations are often treated as a by-product of synthesis. We ask whether diffusion models can instead be trained to learn substantially stronger semantic representations without sacrificing generation quality. SelfFlow takes a step in this direction by introducing self-supervised patch alignment into flow matching, but its main gains remain in faster convergence and improved generation. Inspired by DINO and iBOT, we extend this framework with cross-view class-token alignment to further strengthen semantic representations. Specifically, we form two independently noised, dual-timestep observations of each image and align each student class-token representation with the stop-gradient EMA-teacher target from the other observation. translated_title: 生成中的表征设计：扩散Transformer中的跨视图类标记对齐
translated_abstract: 生成学习与表征学习之间的联系始终是不对称的：语义表征被用来改进扩散生成，而模型自身的表征却常常被视为合成的副产品。我们追问：能否反过来训练扩散模型，使其在不牺牲生成质量的前提下学习到显著更强的语义表征？SelfFlow 通过在流匹配中引入自监督的图像块对齐朝这一方向迈出了一步，但其主要收益仍停留在更快的收敛速度和更好的生成效果上。受 DINO 和 iBOT 的启发，我们通过跨视图类标记对齐来扩展这一框架，以进一步增强语义表征。具体而言，我们为每张图像构造两个独立加噪、双时间步的观测，并将学生的每个类标记表征与来自另一观测的停止梯度 EMA 教师目标进行对齐。该目标与…
tldr: 受 DINO 和 iBOT 启发，该方法在流匹配扩散模型中引入跨视图类标记对齐——对每张图像构造两个独立加噪的双时间步观测，并将学生类标记表征与另一观测的停止梯度 EMA 教师目标对齐——使扩散 Transformer 在不牺牲生成质量的前提下学到更强的语义表征。
en_tdlr: Inspired by DINO and iBOT, this work introduces cross-view class-token alignment into flow-matching diffusion models—forming two independently noised dual-timestep observations per image and aligning each student class token with the stop-gradient EMA-teacher target from the other view—enabling diffusion transformers to learn substantially stronger semantic representations without sacrificing generation quality.
